summary: Frontend testing of TallyDekho Phase 1. All API calls fall back to mock data as expected. Most UI flows work correctly. Critical auth bug found: Register screen is completely skipped because signIn() is called in otp.tsx before navigating to register, causing root layout to immediately redirect to tabs.

ui_bugs.issue: 6 OTP input boxes overflow the card width at 375px mobile viewport. Boxes from index 2+ are outside viewport. The card padding + 6 boxes with gap:10 is too wide.
qa-bottom-close button (bottom circle X) may be outside viewport when modal content is long. The top X button (close-quick-actions) is accessible.

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL BUG: In otp.tsx handleVerify(), signIn(res.token) is called BEFORE router.replace('/(auth)/register') for new users. This sets isAuthenticated=true. Root layout's useEffect detects isAuthenticated=true AND inAuth=true and redirects to /(tabs), completely bypassing the Register screen. Fix: Do NOT call signIn() in otp.tsx for new users - only call signIn() from tally-sync.tsx (which already does it correctly). Store the temp token in a context or route param instead.

action_items: CRITICAL FIX: In otp.tsx, remove the signIn(res.token) call for isNewUser=true case. Instead, pass the token as a route param to register screen. Only call signIn() after registration is complete (tally-sync already handles this). The current code: `await signIn(res.token); if (res?.isNewUser) { router.replace('/(auth)/register', ...) }` causes root layout to redirect away from register immediately.
FIX: OTP boxes in otp.tsx - reduce otpBox flex size or use fixed width (e.g., width: 44) instead of flex:1 with gap:10 so all 6 boxes fit within 375px card width.
OPTIONAL: Add testID to bottom nav tabs in (tabs)/_layout.tsx for better testability.
OPTIONAL: Change FAB testID from 'fab-quick-actions' to 'fab-btn' OR update test scripts to use 'fab-quick-actions'.
OPTIONAL: Change QuickActionsModal container testID to 'quick-actions-modal' (currently uses 'quick-actions-sheet' and 'quick-actions-overlay').
critical_code_review_comments: otp.tsx L59-63: signIn() called before router.replace to register - race condition with AuthContext causes root layout redirect. New user flow is broken.
register.tsx L37: Navigates to /(auth)/tally-sync without calling signIn - this is correct pattern but never reached due to bug above.

Enter name, check terms, click Login button - should navigate to Tally Sync (not directly to Home). Then on Tally Sync click Skip - should navigate to Home Dashboard.
rca_of_issue: Root Cause: otp.tsx handleVerify() calls await signIn(res.token) which sets isAuthenticated=true in AuthContext. Immediately after, it calls router.replace('/(auth)/register'). But _layout.tsx RootNavigation useEffect listens to isAuthenticated and fires: when isAuthenticated=true AND segments[0]==='(auth)', it calls router.replace('/(tabs)'). This override happens before register screen renders. Fix: For new users, do NOT call signIn() in OTP screen. Pass token via route params to register.tsx. In register.tsx after successful registration, pass token to tally-sync.tsx. tally-sync.tsx already calls signIn() correctly.
